summary: Describes the ansible-windows domain test setup files (Vagrantfile, inventory.yml, main.yml) and the default environment: a 2016 domain controller, five child hosts, domain.local, and default local and domain admin credentials, all customizable in inventory.yml.
questions: What does the ansible-windows Vagrant domain environment create?
What are the default credentials in the Windows domain test lab?
How do I change the number of servers in the domain test lab?

answer_card.title: Windows domain test environment
answer_card.answer_md:
Files: `Vagrantfile` (reads inventory, provisions hosts), `inventory.yml` (hosts, IPs, ports), `main.yml` (sets up the DC and joins children).

Defaults:
- AD domain controller on Server 2016
- Five child hosts (one per major Server version)
- Domain `domain.local`
- Local admin `vagrant`/`vagrant`
- Domain admin `vagrant-domain@domain.local` / `VagrantPass1`

Change `domain_*` vars and `domain_children` hosts in `inventory.yml`.
